description: TXN-CLOSE, which recordset Close ends the level (r-txn-1/clone-close-in-transaction, r-fix-cat-txn/clone-close-*: a failed Close raised 3246 and ended the level, an Update alone did not). Eight variants, each on its own Workspace and row, each inside BeginTrans: (1) plain dynaset, Close; (2) dynaset Edit/Update (V = 7777) then Close; (3) dynaset with a clone, Edit/Update on the original, Close the clone; (4) dynaset with a clone, no edit, Close the original; (5) the same, Close the clone; (6) table-type Edit/Update then Close; (7) Edit then CancelUpdate then Close; (8) AddNew/Update of a new row then Close. After each Close: Errors before/after, then Rollback with Errors (3034 means the level had ended), then the row is read. At the end a fresh Workspace reads all rows. Asks what makes Close raise 3246 and end the level.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
